question: What is the percentage increase in the total literacy rate in 2011 over 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9.21%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total literacy rate in India increased from** 64.83% in 2001** to **74.04% in 2011.**
 
• This represents an increase of **9.21** percentage points.
 
• The female literacy rate increased from **53.67%** in 2001 to **65.46%** in 2011.
 
• This represents an increase of** 11.79 **percentage points.
 
• The male literacy rate increased from** 75.26% in 2001 to 82.14% in 2011.**
 
• This represents an increase of **6.88** percentage points.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala had the highest literacy rate in** 2011, at 93.91%.**
 
• Bihar had the lowest literacy rate in **2011, at 61.80%.**
 
• The increase in literacy rate is attributed to various factors, including **government initiatives, increased awareness, and improved access to education.**
 
• The increase in literacy rate has had a positive impact on India's social and economic development.
